Card Q&A.a: Yes. Even if this Digimon is blocked, the effect activates if you declared an attack against your opponent.
Card Q&A.q: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?

Effect: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
